claims.statement: Creation guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and specifies repository admin permission for site creation. This is distinct from writer permission to edit Jekyll content and source-setting maintainer permission.

Prerequisites include Git/Jekyll, with Ruby/Bundler recommendation and macOS Ruby manager troubleshooting. Claims that Bundler prevents environment bugs are recommendations, not guarantees or observed compatibility; no tools installed.

Repository setup supports new/existing sources and includes Free-account public requirement, managed-user organization ownership and private-repository publication warnings. Choosing private repository does not prove private Pages site.

Local init and docs-directory examples require exact target context; orphan gh-pages checkout followed by git rm -rf removes tracked worktree content and is destructive. Example does not authorize deleting this repository's files.

Procedure says repository root for jekyll new after docs-folder selection; preserve context inconsistency and interpret intended current publishing-source directory cautiously. No generator or setup command executed.

Gemfile comments direct Jekyll dependency and adds github-pages with latest supported version placeholder, followed by bundle install. Hosted version link is not current resolved dependency or immutable pin evidence.

Source tells ignoring Gemfile.lock, which sacrifices a committed resolved lock and conflicts with reproducibility objectives. Keep source authority separate from adopted engineering policy; no lock ignored or removed here.

Config example domain/url/baseurl addresses relative paths in subdirectory; domain comment claims HTTPS intent, but config alone does not enforce TLS. Example cloud host does not supply a GHES-specific verified site URL.

Local testing is optional in source. Broad git add and commit/remote/push examples can stage unintended content and conflict with existing origin; they were not executed and are not substitutes for explicit staging and remote identity checks.

Publishing-source config, cloud-only site visibility, Visit site and workflow inspection describe intended rollout. Delay note is ten minutes, admin verified-email push and GITHUB_TOKEN trigger exclusion remain qualified; no actual deployment or reader-access receipt.

All linked setup, version, theme and content pages remain separate evidence. Full pinned guide reviewed reference-only; no policy adoption, rights clearance, native publishing or credential/cost authorization inferred.
